summary: FIR quashing; civil dispute vs criminal proceedings; quashing under Section 482 CrPC requires prima facie lack of criminality; High Court incorrectly dismissed FIR under IPC Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 based on circular invalidity; Registration Act Sections 82-83 permits prosecution initiation by Sub-Registrar; criminality established via forged PoA and sale deed; civil remedy not bar to criminal prosecution; High Court judgment quashed.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Haryana v. Bhajan Lal
Vineet Kumar v. State of Uttar Pradesh
Vijay Kumar Ghai v. State of West Bengal
final_judgment: Criminal appeals allowed; FIR restored; trial court directed to conduct day-to-day hearing; High Court judgment set aside.
